# VirtualContainerCloseAfterEvent Class

> [!CAUTION]
> This class is still in pre-release.  Its signature may change or it may be removed in future releases.

Contains information about a player's virtual container screen that closed, including the contents of the container at that moment.

## Properties

### **container**
`read-only container: VirtualContainer;`

The container whose screen closed.

Type: [*VirtualContainer*](VirtualContainer.md)

### **items**
`read-only items: (ItemStack | undefined)[];`

The contents of every slot of the container when the screen closed. Empty slots are undefined. Storage items such as bundles hold their contents as they were at that moment.

Type: ([*ItemStack*](ItemStack.md) | *undefined*)[]

### **player**
`read-only player: Player;`

The player whose screen closed. When the reason is PlayerLeft the player is no longer valid.

Type: [*Player*](Player.md)

### **reason**
`read-only reason: VirtualContainerCloseReason;`

Why the screen closed.

Type: [*VirtualContainerCloseReason*](VirtualContainerCloseReason.md)
